domain.input: scripts/scoring/v7domain/map.domain.json: read_map.py's domain.json on the published map session (registration 2026-11-18-v7-domain-map-gh200, sha256 bf33f4cc100b86f39179cc8dec3188e6b751f62f941c1986f1c5f3630913201b, public at 556029e1 before any map page), committed; a REQUIRED INPUT, read mechanically
domain.rule (the map registration's, verbatim):
For each decode path p (naive, small-batch, block-scan):
- Take the valid map cells on p in the certified scope (every active expert in one M-tile).
- For each cell, e = dcommon.e_dec(T_v7, T_meas).
- e_ub = max(|T_v7/T_lo - 1|, |T_v7/T_hi - 1|), where T_lo, T_hi = T_meas ∓ 2.306 × 1.2533 × s/√n, and s is the sd of the cell's n clean repeats.
- The candidates are the cells' predicted times. X_p is the smallest candidate X such that every candidate X' ≥ X whose set {T_v7 ≥ X'} holds at least 10 cells has:
  - (i) every e_ub ≤ 6%;
  - (ii) rms e ≤ 2.5%;
  - (iii) |mean e| ≤ 1.0%;
  - and (iv) X_p is the largest of the values this rule gives with each synthetic shape's cells removed in turn.
- A path with no such X is outside the domain.
- D = {decode calls whose path has an X_p, whose T_v7 ≥ X_p, and whose every active expert fits one M-tile}.

Slab guard: over family B's cells under a wave, fit resid_us = a + b·W_e_MB + c·1[T=2]. If b's 95% interval excludes 0 and |b|·35 MB ≥ 1 us, D adds W_e ≥ S, with S chosen by the same rule; otherwise D has no slab condition.
domain.labelling: a cell is IN-DOMAIN when its frozen geometry (path by r3_decode.geometry, T_v7 the registered prediction in us at 6 decimals as the map's, W_e in MB at 6 decimals, the second-tile test by d2common.second_tile) satisfies D: its path has an X_p (verdict IN THE DOMAIN), T_v7 >= X_p, W_e >= S_p when the slab guard set S_p, and every active expert fits one M-tile; else OUT, DESCRIPTIVE (v7dcommon.label)
domain.verification at --final: the readout is committed; it names the map registration at its registered sha256; the map registration's freeze and plan verify (read_map.refusals); its verdict is READ; read_map.domain on the readout's own valid rows gives the same X_p, S_p, verdicts, slab guard and D; D is not empty; the map's session is published and in the census
domain.extrapolation: D has no upper bound: a cell past the map's measured range on its path (T_v7 or W_e above the largest the map timed) is IN-DOMAIN by extrapolation if it meets D. The map measured naive T_v7 <= 445 us, block-scan T_v7 <= 1824 us (small-batch <= 377 us), W_e <= 37.7 MB (block-scan <= 25.2 MB); DeepSeek-V3 has W_e 88 MB and T_v7 207 to 6293 us, so its in-domain cells are extrapolated. The scorer reports each model's in-domain results split into within the map's range and extrapolated, DESCRIPTIVE; the split changes no verdict

minimum: MINIMUM (registered 2026-11-18 with this DRAFT, before D is known): a model is certifiable only when at least 10 of its cells are scored IN-DOMAIN (valid NATIVE main cells after the power check, the page checks, row_drop, GD2's and G3-D shuffle's voids, second-tile cells excluded, and labelled IN-DOMAIN). A model with fewer is reported with its in-domain statistics, labelled BELOW THE MINIMUM and NOT CERTIFIED whatever they read; its in-domain cells still count in the pooled bar. The pooled bar is over every scored in-domain cell of every model not voided. --final refuses when D is empty (the map registration: if D is empty, no domain blind runs) or when no model has 10 registered in-domain cells (nothing could be certified)
inherited blocks: the frozen blind scorer's rivals (rental 7's rule), RIVALS_ALL_CELLS, KNEE_D, SIGMA_D, G3-D label, its all-cell pooled_over and its all-cell E1-DEC are reported DESCRIPTIVE over every scored cell, in and out of D, under names saying so; no verdict reads them (the certification is the rule above, unchanged); GD2's and G3-D shuffle's voids apply as registered
claim if certified: v7 predicts vLLM's fused MoE decode call on GH200 within 3% rms / 8% worst on unseen models, inside D (per certified model); a fail closes decode
scope line: Certified domain: decode calls in which every active expert fits in one M-tile (at most BLOCK_M rows). Calls where an expert needs a second M-tile (the most concentrated routing at T >= 32) are not certified; they are reported as the descriptive SIGMA-D row. Certification covers time as a function of the expert counts only: it does not cover a dependence on which experts are active (Mixtral's published expert-set effect, up to about 2.5 us at R 1). G3-D label, the test of that dependence, is DESCRIPTIVE (addendum 3, owner 2026-10-29 and 2026-11-03): it is reported per model and neither stops the CAL2 reading nor voids a blind model's certification; G3-D shuffle and GD2 void as registered.
